column1: # covered_by_main: true = pipeline.yml already triggers it on PRs when this file changes;
#   main-base-only = same, but only for PRs whose base is main (backport PRs get our dry-run).
# Deliberately NOT mapped (static tag check + probes only):
#   pipeline.elastic-agent-binary-dra.yml  4 big packaging builds, YAML `notify` slack can't be
#     disabled by env, dra-prep is skipped on PRs, and its branch filter may block the trigger.
#   pipeline.version-bump.yml  no plugins; Slack + release automation, no dry-run.
#   scripts/upload_dra_staging.sh  step only runs on main/release branches.
